tagline: Increased data source limit: Each Genie Agent supports up to 50 tables, views, or metric views as data sources, up from 30.
what_it_does: Increased data source limit: Each Genie Agent supports up to 50 tables, views, or metric views as data sources, up from 30. Increased conversation limit: Each Genie Agent can store up to 200,000 conversations, up from 10,000. Create, share, and manage a Genie Agent, the natural language chat interface that business users use to ask questions of their data in Databricks.
why_it_matters: Before sharing the agent with users, Databricks recommends adding example SQL queries, instructions, and knowledge store configurations to improve response accuracy.
plain_summary: Increased data source limit: Each Genie Agent supports up to 50 tables, views, or metric views as data sources, up from 30. Increased conversation limit: Each Genie Agent can store up to 200,000 conversations, up from 10,000.
